name: Hive
summary: Project management and team collaboration in one workspace. Plan projects, assign tasks and centralize communication so work keeps moving.
best_for: project teams that want flexible PM (Gantt, Kanban, forms, chat) and only pay for the modules they actually use
skip_if: you need most of the add-ons anyway (all-inclusive tools price better), or your org demands one standardized suite
honest_knock: The seat price is honest bait, the add-on grid is the business model: switch on three add-ons and your $12 seat becomes $27 — a la carte flexibility that punishes teams who need the full toolkit. List your must-have modules first and compare the DRESSED price against all-inclusive rivals; for teams needing only core PM, though, Hive is genuinely cheap and pleasant.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month, yearly billing
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-03) Free forever for up to 10 workspace members, with 1,000 AI credits a month and 200MB of storage; Starter $5 per user a month and Teams $12 per user a month on yearly billing, which the page states saves 33% against monthly; Enterprise is custom. Read the Starter row before you pay for it: it lifts storage to unlimited and AI credits to 3,000 a month, but it keeps the same 10-member cap as Free and adds a 10-project cap. Only Teams, at $12 with 5,000 AI credits, gives unlimited workspace members. The add-ons are the part to budget: proofing and approvals, timesheets, team resourcing, advanced dashboards, SSO and enterprise controls, and external users each cost $5 per user a month on top, which their own calculator confirms. Two further add-ons, CRM and Finance, are listed on the page with no price at all. The external-user add-on includes 5 external licences per seat.
